title: Multiphysics Frameworks for Computational Homogenization
exact_target: Develop homogenization frameworks that handle dissipation and broader resonances while balancing accuracy, efficiency and flexibility across coupled physical fields.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005839 (OWR-14298167-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Multiscale Design of Advanced Materials and Structures (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/11, pp. 657--730. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The source is a comparative modelling programme and supplies no universal accuracy functional or single optimal framework.
